profileLabel: Mixed economics; mixed civil liberties; institution-supporting
summary: Quezon City 1st District representative with 101 principal-authored bills. Pro-worker bills (platform workers, security of tenure) sit beside travel-tax abolition and flexible working time. He authored SOGI anti-discrimination, but also false-information penalties and a national cybersecurity agency. Strongest pattern is on transparency: FOI, anti-dynasty and election-technology bills.
caveat: Extractor shortlisted about 17 of 101 bills; unlisted bills were not reviewed. Disinformation bills may carry safeguards not visible here. No votes reviewed.

economic.label: Center / mixed
economic.rationale: Platform-worker rights and security of tenure (-3) offset by travel-tax abolition (+2) and flexible working time for private firms (+1). Documented mix of labor-protective and tax-cutting positions.
